item.title: Yattee v1.5.1
item.description:
Yattee 1.5.1 | Yattee-1.5.1-iOS
## What's Changed
* support for private instances by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/565 * honour the aspect ratio when resizing by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/562 * make links in description clickable by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/560 * make description collapsible by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/559 * macOS: disable hit testing when not expanded by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/578 * disable portraitUpsideDown on iPhones by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/569 * make chapters collapsible and highlight current chapter by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/564 * more robust regex for chapters from description by @stonerl in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/597 * Translations update from Weblate * Added Persian, Spanish, Turkish and Russian localizations * Other changes and improvements ## New Contributors * @stonerl made their first contribution in https://github.com/yattee/yattee/pull/565
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yattee/yattee/compare/v1.5...v1.5.1
